name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Claude Code Configuration for Developers
short_description: Claude Code Configuration is a comprehensive toolkit for developers, featuring customizable rules, hooks, agents, and commands to enhance productivity. Perfect for those looking to optimize their coding environment with AI-driven solutions.
author: jarrodwatts

sections.overview:
Claude Code Configuration is a toolkit for developers using Claude Code that enables standardization of coding practices through path-scoped rules, custom hooks, and reusable agents. It includes components for enforcing TypeScript conventions, managing code comments, automating todo tracking, and running custom commands like interviews. The configuration system supports multiple agents for specialized tasks such as codebase searching, documentation writing, and media interpretation. Developers can define global instructions and skill reminders to maintain consistency across projects. This approach reduces manual configuration overhead and ensures team-wide adherence to coding standards.
Customize AI agent behavior for specific coding tasks to improve efficiency.
Integrate hooks that automate workflows, reducing manual intervention.
Manage and maintain configuration files for various development environments seamlessly.
Create and store reusable code snippets to speed up coding processes.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
